ns2:course.label: Elementary Hindi-Urdu I
ns2:course.description: (HINDI 201) Introduction to the Hindi/Urdu language; includes conversation with a native Hindi/Urdu-speaking tutor under the direction of a linguist instructor, and a minimum of formal grammar and Devanagari writing; introduction to Arabic-Persian script by arrangement. All students are required to register for one hour per week in the language laboratory.
